contact_ceiling_arithmetic.assertion: the loader raises 'program contact ceiling must equal the bounded native graph ceiling' unless program.max_contacts equals the computed ceiling, which is why this cell binds the new policy fragment phase-native-candidates-review-revise-clean1-v1 (max_contacts 13) rather than the anchor's phase-native-candidates-review-revise-v1 (max_contacts 11); verified on this tree, see deviation 1 of the preregistration
contact_ceiling_arithmetic.formula: ceiling = perception.max_iterations + (max_revisions + 1) * (sum over the other roles of role.max_iterations * (samples if solver else 1) + sum over cleaned boundaries of consumer.max_iterations) + max_refreshes * perception.max_iterations

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. Do not automatically restart, replay, filter rows, change the roster, role graph, prompts, geometry or caps. At most one root-diagnosed recovery may be separately registered; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism.

fit.live: every flight fits each realized request itself through build_native_contact_fit_gate; coordinate-fit is not run, because the native gate already charges the FIT row

hash_caveat: Every composed and protocol hash in this package is the value of the five config fragments exactly as committed at the registration commit: readiness held, the preparation requirement present, prepared_phase_supply pinned, no decision requirement. core.config.compose hashes the whole merged document, so flipping readiness to ready and appending the coordinator's decision requirement each change the composed hash and therefore the protocol hash. Re-pin with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py (core.flight.repin) before launch; never edit a hash by hand. The method is verified on this tree: composing slurp-native-dual-store-train-fold-a-anchor-v1 as both baseline and experiment reproduces the sealed anchor's registered protocol hash d1c61c09102dcb8801ea134d763fca0b5b60054d6ef80a3a38752642c107c87d.
